items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

ctx.x: Do I have to hook up?

I don’t know. Just hook him up there, Tim, and I’ll just wrap this up. Yeah that’s a beautiful, I’ll send you, I’ll burn it on a little CD for you and send it because it’s just totally gorgeous. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
God. Every day I listen to this old stuff from the archives at Pacific. And it gets me so emotional to hear.
